notes.title: Bug fixes and UI improvements
notes.notes: In this version we've fixed several bugs and improved the VR UI.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes and improvement for VR camera system
notes.notes:
We've improved the initial POV position in VR.
You will notice that your initial POV position now uses a camera tilt which makes for a much easier viewing angle.

notes.title: Minor bug fix related to eyes blinking
notes.notes: We've fixed a bug where character's eyes would stay shut for a long period of time instead of a quick blink.
